elements.requirement: Compensation payable in respect of land of another local authority must arise in pursuance of a compulsory purchase under section 17 (provision of housing), section 290 (acquisition of land for clearance), or section 300 (purchase of condemned house for temporary housing use).
elements.quote: section 17 (provision of housing), ,section 290 (acquisition of land for clearance), orsection 300 (purchase of condemned house for temporary housing use)

elements.requirement: The alternative payment provision applies to compensation that would otherwise be paid into court in accordance with Schedule 1 to the Compulsory Purchase Act 1965 regarding purchase from persons not having power to dispose.
elements.quote: which would otherwise be paid into court in accordance with Schedule 1 to the Compulsory Purchase Act 1965 (purchase from persons not having power to dispose)

elements.requirement: The payment and application of the compensation in an alternative manner is conditional on the consent of the Secretary of State.
elements.quote: if the Secretary of State consents

elements.requirement: Where the Secretary of State consents, the compensation may instead be paid and applied in such manner as the Secretary of State may determine.
elements.quote: instead be paid and applied as he may determine
